notes: Scene: a bare single-stage Gifford-McMahon cold head, not a cryostat. Geometry from Cryomech drawing CH1A600 rev A (supersedes CH10600): 241.3 mm room-temperature flange; 267.7 mm motor housing with two eyebolts above the flange; 127 mm diameter cold cylinder 307.8 mm long below the flange ending in a bare copper heat exchanger (8x M10 on 101.6 mm BC). Two 3/4 inch Aeroquip helium couplings exit the side 57.2 mm above the flange, reaching 237.8 mm from the axis. Cold head weight 42 kg. Separate water-cooled CPA1114 compressor 61 x 61 x 79 cm, 191 kg, 440/480 VAC 3-phase 60 Hz, 12.5 kW, joined by two 3 m (10 ft) 1 inch ID flex lines (6.8 kg per pair) and a motor cord of the same length. Performance: 600 W at 80 K certified at 60 Hz, 510 W at 70 K, 350 W at 50 K, <=25 K no load, <1 h cooldown. The spec sheet's '430 W at 600 K' is a typo for the 60 K point. Animation: displacer reciprocates inside the cold cylinder at an unpublished GM rate; compressor hum at mains frequency; helium pulses in the flex lines. Sources: spec sheet (Oct 28 2024), product page, CH1A600 cold head drawing, AL600 CPA1114 system drawing rev E (snapshots research/v5/cache/4cbe6c75b1d7a4bb.txt, 6b7370d24a1c1775.txt, 03ec8b940f752b63.txt, 35bcf16c6a699f01.txt).
